item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hi there! Welcome to your weather report for Tuesday, November 17. It's Tuesday, and the week is getting going. Today in Shanghai, it will be a little bit rainy. Temperatures will go up to 18 degrees, with a low of 12. It will feel just right out there. The chance of rain is 14 percent. The sun goes down at 4:54 this evening, about 1 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? If it rains later, look up afterwards. Sometimes a rainbow comes out to say hello. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be drizzly, with a high of 15 degrees. This week is all about taking turns. What is your favourite part? That's all from the weather desk. Enjoy your day!
